goal.note: Strategy: train for 3:30 so that a rough day still banks 3:45 and a bad day stays under 4:00. Race date assumed 2027 - edit if different.

zonesNote: Zones are anchored to CURRENT fitness (threshold ~5:15/km, from real runs - 10.4km @5:17 HR162, benchmark 4:54 @HR149), not to the goal. They only move when the data says so: the dashboard checkpoint banner proposes new zones after a faster 5K/10K/half, and the Build-phase test half recalibrates everything. Reference: 3:30 marathon shape eventually needs threshold ~4:50/km - the plan walks you there via evidence, never by decree. Coach's rule: threshold must FEEL sustainable 50-70 min; if a rep cooks you, it was too fast.

schedule.comment: JS day numbers: 0=Sunday 1=Monday ... 6=Saturday. Wed+Sat are no-run days.

races.name: Leopoldilauf Halbmarathon
races.title: RACE — Leopoldilauf Half (baseline)
steps: Job: honest baseline, 23 weeks out — information, not glory. You come off a cutback week; no extra taper
Warm-up: 3 km very easy + drills + 4 strides, timed to finish ~10 min before the 10:00 gun
Loop 1 (7 km) @ 5:30/km — must feel embarrassingly easy
Loop 2 (7 km) @ 5:20/km — settle in and work
Loop 3 (7 km) @ 5:10/km or faster on feel — earn the finish · ≈1:52:30 (band 1:52–1:55)
Fuel: breakfast 2 h before · water + salt only · nibble ~10 g carbs from 10 min before, ~40 g/h during
Cool-down 1–2 km jog · next 2–3 days easy — the recovery ladder applies

races.name: 1. VCM Winterlauf 10k
races.title: RACE — 1. VCM Winterlauf 10k (THE checkpoint)
steps: Job: the season's honest fitness checkpoint — replaced Adventlauf (handball tournament Dec 4). Flat, AIMS-measured Prater Hauptallee = perfect for accurate zone recalibration
9 days after the handball tournament: legs fully back, no excuses
Warm-up: 3 km easy + drills + 4 strides
Km 1–3 @ 5:05/km — controlled, breathing quiet
Km 4–7 @ 4:58/km — goal marathon pace, locked
Km 8–10 @ 4:48/km — empty the tank · ≈49:30 (band 49:30–51:00) · sub-50 = goal MP held for 10 km
Fuel: breakfast 2 h before · water + salt · nibble from 10 min before the gun
Cool-down 2–3 km very easy · the result recalibrates your zones

races.name: San Silvestre Vallecana 10k
races.title: RACE — San Silvestre 10k (fun, hard)
steps: Job: hard festive effort — race on EFFORT; the crowd decides what the clock says
Evening race: main meal ~14:00, light carb snack 2 h before, nibble from 10 min before
Warm-up: 2–3 km easy + strides, as space allows
First 5 km: controlled ~5:00/km effort — don't fight the crowd, surf it
Second 5 km: build 4:55 → 4:45 — pass people all the way · 48:30–50:30 with clear road
Enjoy it — finishing the year racing is the point. Sunday's long run after this: short and genuinely easy

races.name: Eisbärlauf Halbmarathon
races.title: TEST RACE — Eisbärlauf Half
steps: The Build-phase exam — this result decides the Specific phase and recalibrates every zone
Warm-up: 3 km easy + drills + 4 strides
Loop 1 (7 km) @ 5:05/km — patient
Loop 2 (7 km) @ 4:57/km — the race pace of the day
Loop 3 (7 km) @ 4:48/km on courage · ≈1:44:20 · 1:44–1:46 untapered = green light for 3:30
Full race rehearsal: breakfast 2 h before · water + salt · nibble from −10 min · 40–60 g carbs/h · race shoes
Cool-down 1–2 km · then the recovery ladder: walk days → test jog → gym re-engagement

overrides.title: HANDBALL TOURNAMENT (80% likely)
steps: Tournament day — if you play, this IS the week's hard stimulus (planned Chest gym is cancelled)
Warm up properly before the first game — sprints + cuts on cold legs is how runners get hurt
Between games: keep moving, carbs + fluids like a long run — the nibble protocol works here too
After: real meal within the hour, legs up
If you end up NOT playing: do the normal Chest gym instead, and Sunday's long run runs as planned

append: IF YOU PLAYED HANDBALL YESTERDAY: cap this at 8–10 km relaxed Z2, or skip entirely if anything (ankles/knees/adductors) complains — day-after-tournament + full long run is an injury bet, and the checkpoint race is in 7 days
If you skipped the tournament: run the long run as planned

overrides.title: Handball tournament (light)
steps: Tournament day — replaces the Chest gym; you expect it to be easy on the legs
Warm up properly before the first game anyway — sprints + cuts on cold legs is the risk, not the volume
Carbs + fluids between games (nibble protocol), real meal within the hour after

append: DAY AFTER HANDBALL: run as planned, but let the first 2 km be the assessment — heavy legs or any ankle/knee/adductor complaint = shorten without guilt
Start a notch slower than usual; handball soreness often only shows up once you're warm
GENUINELY easy today — yesterday was effectively a Z3 progression run in ~36°C (2nd half avg HR 154, decoupling +3.8%). HR under 140, pace 6:30+, shorten without guilt if the hamstrings still talk

After the run: hip-flexor micro-session #1 — banded psoas march 2×10/side + half-kneeling hip-flexor isometric holds 3×20–30s/side. Effort ≤3/10, no aggressive stretching. Green = any ache settled by tomorrow morning
Hip-flexor check-in: Monday's micro-session should have settled overnight. If it did — all green. If not — skip hip work until Friday and keep this run easy-easy
Left hip flexor rule for every run this week: pain that grows while running = stop. Warm-up ache that fades = OK

overrides.title: Gym — Legs (hamstring volume capped)
steps: Pattern from last two weeks: legs Wednesday → hamstring DOMS peaks Friday (cost the Aug 14 steady run). Fix: cap hamstring eccentrics — RDL 2×8 at a lighter weight (was 3×10), everything else unchanged
Squats 4×8 · Walking lunges 3×12/leg · Single-leg glute bridge 3×10/leg · Plank 3×45s
Calf raises may return light (shin cleared): 2×12, stop if any shin echo
Leave feeling worked, not wrecked — tomorrow is the first threshold session in weeks; the gym serves the running
Post-gym: protein within 20 min

overrides.title: Threshold returns — 3×8 min (conservative re-entry)
steps: Dose deliberately small for the first threshold back: 3 × 8 min @ 5:05–5:25 (HR guide Z4 162–172), 2 min jog recoveries
Warm-up 2 km easy + 2–3 strides. HIP FLEXOR GATE: if it speaks in the warm-up and doesn't fade → convert to steady 5:55–6:15. One session costs nothing 35 weeks out
Heat rule: don't chase pace — if HR runs away mid-rep or it's another 30°+ morning, cut to 2×8 and call it a win
CARRY: DM320 bottle (pre-chilled) — threshold day = fuel-during day; keep the 50ml/~10min sips
Cool-down 1–2 km easy — no fast finish

append: After Back gym: hip-flexor micro-session #2 (same dose as Monday) — only if Monday's settled by the next morning; otherwise rest it and reassess Sunday
HONEST Z2 — last week's lesson: HR cap 148, no km under 6:00. The Warsaw feeling lives at the end of the plan, not mid-August
Heat: start early. Pre-chill the DM320 and carry/plan plain water alongside it — then judge the 'heavy' feel again at true Z2 before changing anything in the race plan
Hold ~90 min — the 90→100 min bump waits until the heatwave breaks
